_about: Weights for src/score. How to tune: docs/scoring-notes.md. Every change gets a line in _changes with its reason.
_changes: 2026-10-15 first weights (M2), from PLAN.md's first-ranking signals
2026-10-15 clusterGapSeconds 6 -> 12: the hand-picked round-8 3k on the October de_inferno demo (M0 interval B) has kills 11.5 s and 9.0 s apart and fell apart into three single kills at 6
2026-10-15 includeOvertime false: PLAN.md section 3 excludes overtime rounds; set true to rank them
2026-10-15 per-round moments (Peder): all of his kills in a round are one moment, so clusterGapSeconds is gone; quick succession is a scoring signal instead

2026-10-15 tightness: the most kills inside any windowSeconds (6 s) earn perKillInWindow each beyond the first, all kills within allWithinSeconds earn allWithinBonus, and speed now scores the tightest run, so a 3k in 4 s beats a 3k over 40 s by about 30 points (Peder: quick succession is worth more)

2026-10-15 light signals (Peder: a small bonus each, never enough to lift a weak round over a strong one): noscope moved from flags into light, airborne (attackerinair), one-bullet kills, flicks (yaw turned in the 100-200 ms before the kill shot above minDegrees); capped together at maxPerMoment, below the 20-point gap between kill counts

2026-10-15 recalibrated (Peder: keep minScore 40; anchor: the moments that scored about 40 in the 46-moment batch must land about 40 again, and a plain 2k must not gain a flat 18): tightness pays only from the third kill in the 6 s window (perKillBeyondTwo 15), allWithin bonus removed; a 2k scores as before (its pace is in speed), a 3k in 4 s still beats a 3k over 40 s by about 19

2026-10-15 style as per-kill multipliers (Peder): the capped flat light bonuses are replaced by factors on each kill's share of the kill base: one-bullet kill 1.5, flick over 25 degrees 1.5, no-scope 1.4, airborne 1.3, stacking on the kill. Two one-tap flicks in a 2k score about double a plain 2k (kills 30 -> 67.5); a single kill with every style is about 41, below any strong 3k; plain kills keep factor 1, so the minScore 40 anchor holds

2026-10-15 economy multiplier per round (Peder): the round's score times a capped function of enemy/own equipment value at freeze end (1 + 0.2 ln ratio, within 0.7..1.4); a farmed eco counts less, an eco won against a full buy more; within 25 percent of parity it moves the score at most 5 percent, so the minScore 40 anchor holds; pistol rounds 1 and 13 are parity
2026-10-15 flickMinDegrees 25 -> 15 (Peder): on the 29 stored demos only 2 of 531 gun kills turned more than 25 degrees into the kill shot, 8 more than 15; at 25 the flick almost never counted

2026-10-15 two flick tiers (Peder): 15-45 degrees keeps flick 1.5; 45 degrees or more is a big flick, bigFlick 2.5 on that kill. On the 29 stored demos no gun kill reaches 45 (max 35 of 531), so nothing moves today

2026-10-15 round outcome as a multiplier (Peder): the flat roundWon +8 is replaced by x1.1 for a won round and x0.9 for a lost one on the round's whole score, a light weight for impact; the clutch won bonus stays separate

2026-10-15 facing per kill (Peder): the victim looking within 60 degrees of him at the kill tick multiplies that kill's share by 1.1, a kill from behind by 0.9 (few bullets in the back is easy); unknown angles count 1

2026-10-15 hand-pick fixes (Peder: 63 and 29 > 90, 13 > 84/105): clutch scales with enemies and with the share killed (1v1 with one kill 10, 1v2 30, 1v3 50, ...; lost x0.3); the low-HP penalty skips a victim his own damage brought low and is capped at 8 per moment; economy multiplies only the kill points; new direction spread bonus (yaw turned between the tightest run's kills, 4 points above 60 degrees, +2 per 45 degrees, at most 10)

speed._note: scored on the tightest run (the best tightness window), not the whole round

tightness._note: kills in quick succession: each kill beyond the second inside the best windowSeconds window; a 2k's pace is already in speed

spread._note: direction spread: the yaw he turned between consecutive kills of the tightest run, summed; above minDegrees it earns points, a kill turned through several directions

clutch._note: value by opponents (index = enemies alive at the clutch start, 5 for 5+), times the share of them he killed in the clutch (at least half), times lostFactor when lost

style._note: per-kill multipliers on that kill's share of the kill base; they stack on the kill (a one-tap flick is 1.5 x 1.5 = 2.25). A flick of bigFlickMinDegrees or more counts bigFlick instead of flick. A kill with none is 1.0, so plain rounds keep their scores

economy._note: multiplies the kill points (kills and style), not the round's other parts: 1 + perLnRatio x ln(enemy buy / own buy) at freeze end, kept within min..max; pistol rounds count as parity

roundOutcome._note: the round's score times won or lost, after economy; a clutch won keeps its own clutch.wonBonus

lowHp._note: a victim at or below threshold HP before the killing hit, damaged by someone else first, costs penaltyPerKill; his own earlier damage on that victim does not count; at most maxPerMoment
